title: 52-bit-VA gated Y-cluster joint-2X 7x37b birthday search on secp256k1 at 123.521388662669609 (disjoint VA, HB=47, DLVHB=31, MX=12)

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md on a 52-bit-VA generator/relay/home machine recovers x with unconditional single-run probability at least 0.3901 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins: before any node work, one coordinator draws a fresh 128-bit RNDR coin u and tests u < K_GATE = 132917291944920932309227833155252984270 (p_gate = K_GATE/2^128 = 0.390608815, kernels/route.s gate, GATE = 256 instructions charged unconditionally on every run), halting immediately with no output if u >= K_GATE and otherwise running a q1 = 11,600,000,000-batch search (G = 1536 power-law groups m_g = floor(q1*(g/1536)^(28/32)), certified opened-run success lo_run >= 0.998697380855 via Chen-Stein on cross-cluster leaf pairs across 2^58 clusters of M_G=1024 generators with halving-and-squaring e^-mu enclosure and Lemmas L and C in success.md 6.4-6.7, giving p_gate * lo_run >= 0.3901). Its unconditional expected total work E_total = 256 + p_gate * E_run is at most 2^123.521388662669609 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 scalar AArch64 instructions per unit; opened run E_run <= 2^124.877593 units, at most 75.5860 instructions per leaf of S = 2^128.603331), and the worst case on every run, 2^179.732111 instructions, is disclosed. Each of 2^68 generators (grouped into 2^58 rings of 1024 generators forwarding 448-byte Y-records via ysnd/ydlv/ydlve in [34 TiB, 59 TiB) at <=32 instructions per Y) holds MX=12 permanent X's (6 X-pairs) with joint 2-X paired 64-byte LD64B 7-window (37,37,37,37,37,37,34)-bit tables in TTBR0 [59 TiB, 2^51) (1,989 TiB exact) and 43-bit beta tables in TTBR1 [2^64-2^51, 2^64), running 6-pair linear Montgomery chains with LKP7_PAIR and LD64B B^2 loads (fwd 67.6667/inc), Y-hoisted EFG_PAIR_6 lookups stored in-place via ST64B, P1_7WIN direct (u^2, v^2) from inv^2, dual window-0 LD64B PAIRB6 and 3xLD64B BWDONE7_J0 (bwd 1042.0833/inc), ST64B fraction lines and 3x-unrolled KEYPAIR7 key passes (keys 128.1667/inc); 2^42 relays (h2s 95/16) and 2^84 homes (HB=47 hash buckets at 2^64-2^52, 4,777-TiB signed-VA R2 [-682 TiB, 4,095 TiB) pairwise-disjoint from MMIO link window 2^52-2^40 and counters, K2B=16, DLVHB=31, 256-byte DC ZVA BS=6) synchronize via store-release messages, DMB ISH, 128-bit/STADDL counters and two-wave link barriers (sections 2, 4, 5). Peak memory at most 2^136.9996 bytes; opened-run preprocessing at most 2^117.0429 units, included in E_run and E_total; no advice; the three expanded kernels assemble with LLVM with 0 errors and instruction counts equal to a64_load's (23,619, 3,777, 2,033); certificate.py checks all intervals, pairwise VA/MMIO disjointness and figures.

experiments.purpose: Verifies yround 7-window Y-chain generation, MX=12 7x37b/P1/LS64 leaf kernels against bit-exact models and affine curve addition, plain-dict tbld-constructed table consumption and mutant rejections across all four table geometries (experiment.py, sites.py), pairwise-disjoint 52-bit-VA generator/relay/home + Y-ring machine with 64B-aligned LINK+64 block windows, two-wave completion and LS64/VA52/encoding-form mutant rejections (machine.py), 128-bit coordinator gate_checks and 4,777-TiB signed-VA R2 wraparound, and every kernel count against certificate.py.
